feedback_boundary: Round-level qualitative feedback; no invented individual ratings, visual ranking or causal interpretation.
scope: Frozen v5 dev2000, nested same dev_monitor500 with saved flash outcomes, seven completed models (E42,E64,E65 geometry/feature,E66 unshared/shared,E67 group). E67 incomplete global omitted. Tests sealed, no training, optimizer, new postprocessing or checkpoint reselection.
new_computation: Frozen E42 and E65 eval/no_grad forwards on dev2000 only to obtain missing E42 per-case terms and unsaved module-level diagnostics; verify E65 stored terms and E42 stored aggregate. questions: How much balanced-panel Loss variation is shared case difficulty versus model main effect and interaction?
Which terms and modules dominate high-Loss cases, including mechanical local-area normalization?
Which public task features and reference structure associate with Loss after controlling module count?
Does G rank overlap and saved flash outcomes across cases and within the same case?
Are gains concentrated on some task strata, and which concrete cases contradict simple interpretations?
methods: Distribution/tail concentration, weighted-term decomposition, descriptive two-way sums of squares, Spearman and N-adjusted partial-rank association, worker-cluster bootstrap for key paired/ranking summaries, fixed ridge regression on log G with five worker-held-out folds. Input-only versus label-assisted explanatory features explicitly separated; no causal claims or independent test/generalization claims.
case_validation: At most five unique dev cases for implementation validation, distinct from the requested full descriptive analysis. Reuse existing quality outcomes; no repeated terminal scoring.
reference_state_note: Setting raw state to original supervised centers/log-ratios and decoding with transformed public areas may have nonzero G. This diagnostic is not an optimum/lower bound and is never used as network input.
interpretation: Single-seed adaptively exposed development evidence. Case statistics describe saved candidates and this distribution. Regression association, local-area denominators and reference structure do not establish causal generation mechanisms. No human-quality calibration without case ratings.
